provenance.description: PLANTED known-diagnosis case: a lid-driven cavity whose moving-lid velocity boundary condition is malformed, so the solver FATAL-errors on field U. The experiment as executed is broken and says nothing about the hypothesis.
provenance.authorship: hand-authored for the Step-20.7 triage battery; NOT a real run
provenance.expected_diagnosis: setup_error - a broken/unbuildable boundary condition; the run failed

chosen_hypothesis.statement: Raising the lid velocity from 1.0 to 2.0 m/s increases the volume-averaged cavity flow speed roughly linearly.
chosen_hypothesis.rationale: In the low-Re laminar regime the interior speed scales with the driving lid speed; a two-point sweep tests the linearity.

experiment_spec.title: Lid-speed sweep of mean cavity flow speed
experiment_spec.objective: Measure volume-averaged flow speed at lid 1.0 and 2.0 m/s in the baseline 2D cavity.

qoi.name: mean_flow_speed
qoi.definition: Volume-averaged velocity magnitude at the final time.
qoi.how_extracted: volAverage of mag(U) at the latest written time.

success_criterion.statement: Mean flow speed at lid 2.0 m/s exceeds 0.3 m/s.

regime.notes: Steady laminar recirculating cavity; Re = U*L/nu spans 100 to 200, inside the 2D-laminar validated envelope.

mini_experiment.expected_observation: Both runs converge; mean speed at lid 2.0 is roughly twice that at lid 1.0, near 0.42 vs near 0.21 m/s.

fidelity_verdict.label: trust
fidelity_verdict.rationale: baseline cavity inside the validated laminar envelope

error_lines: Essential entry 'value' missing for the movingWall patch of field U
the moving-lid velocity boundary condition is malformed and the case is unbuildable

expectation.note: The moving-lid U boundary condition is malformed, the solver FATAL-errored, nothing executed - the outcome says nothing about the hypothesis: setup_error. The fix is a setup/design correction, so exit is the one wrong decision.
